# REAL TEAM, s.r.o.

> A Slovak travel agency (cestovná kancelária) based in Bratislava that organises
> tailor-made sports travel and stays for clubs, teams and sport communities.
> It has held a travel agency licence since 1994. Main destinations: Mallorca and
> Albania, plus destinations chosen by the group.

## Facts

- Legal name: REAL TEAM, s.r.o.
- Company ID (IČO): 31 369 049
- VAT ID (IČ DPH): SK2020873745
- Commercial register: Mestský súd Bratislava III, section Sro, insert no. 6700/B
- Registered office: Pri kríži 18, 841 02 Bratislava, Slovakia
- Managing director: Jakub Popluhár
- Contact: jakub@realteamsport.eu
- Website: https://realteamsport.eu (Slovak) and https://realteamsport.eu/en/ (English)
- Insolvency protection under Slovak Act No. 170/2018 Coll., insurer Union poisťovňa, a.s.
- Own brand for its own trips: Future Roundnet, https://futureroundnet.com

## What it sells

REAL TEAM sells **sports travel (športové cesty)**: accommodation and meals, rooming
lists and individual payments, airport transfers and local transport, training
facilities and excursions during the stay. It arranges travel; it does not sell
tickets to events or run standalone camps.

## Own trip: FRESH

FRESH is REAL TEAM's own sports trip to Mallorca, run under the Future Roundnet
brand. The last edition ran 8 to 15 March 2026 at Hotel Fontanellas Playa. The next
dates are FRESH 27 in March 2027.
